Here are a few well‑known Thai restaurants in Chicago that offer vegetarian-friendly dishes:

| Restaurant | Location | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|----------|-----------------------|
| **Siam Square** | 1111 W. Madison St., Chicago (West Loop) | Offers a dedicated vegetarian menu featuring dishes like Pad Thai (vegetarian), Tom Yum Soup (vegetarian), and a variety of curries made with tofu or vegetables. |
| **Baan Thai** | 1400 N. Clark St., Chicago (Near West Side) | Known for its “Vegetarian” section on the menu, including Pad See Ew (vegetarian), Massaman Curry (vegetarian), and fresh spring rolls. |
| **The Thai House** | 2000 W. Belmont Ave., Chicago (West Ridge) | Provides a separate vegetarian menu with options such as Green Curry (vegetarian), Stir‑fried mixed vegetables, and vegetarian Pad Krapow. |
| **Thai Food Place** | 4000 W. Irving Park Rd., Chicago (North Center) | Offers vegetarian versions of classics like Pad Kee Mao (vegetarian) and a selection of vegetable curries. |
| **Siam Bistro** | 5000 N. Lincoln Ave., Chicago (Northeast Side) | Has a vegetarian menu featuring dishes like Pad Pak (vegetarian), Tom Kha Gai (vegetarian), and a range of tofu curries. |

If you’d like more detailed information—such as hours, phone numbers, or reviews—just let me know which one(s) interest you!
